Hi Kara — quick answers inline to your questions and next steps.

1) Marketplace & custom DPA: Our CloudPartner marketplace currently supports a vendor-standard DPA. For customers requiring custom DPAs we typically run the PO route (vendor paperflow) so Legal can exchange redlines and sign. That said, we can expedite a marketplace-compatible amendment for certain enterprise customers — Lauren is on copy to advise on feasibility for Holloway.

2) SOC 2 Type II report: We can provide the full Type II under an NDA. For speed, the attached RI_Security_Overview.pdf contains the executive summary and a controls map. If your security team needs the full report, we can route an NDA and provide the report within 2 business days after NDA execution. Contact for security follow-ups: security-answers@redwood.ai.

3) KMS / PHI: Redwood supports customer-managed keys (KMS) for Private deployments and can integrate via AWS KMS or GCP KMS for cloud regions. For hosted SaaS we offer a bring-your-own-key option on Dedicated/Private plans; we'll need to confirm the exact requirements with our infra team. Monica — can you confirm feasibility for Holloway if they need managed keys for PHI in a hosted setup?

Proposed next steps:
- Kara confirms preferred route by EOD Monday (PO vs marketplace).
- If PO: Kara to share procurement contact details and PO template or send initial PO. Redwood to put Legal on a fast path for DPA redlines. Lauren will coordinate commercial terms / any enterprise credits.
- If marketplace: Kara / Tom confirm marketplace account and we will provide the onboarding link and cost breakdown.

I can draft a mutual action plan once you confirm the route — attaching a one-pager M.A.P. draft here (internal doc link).
